name: CareLogic by Qualifacts
short_description: ONC-certified, web-based EHR from Qualifacts for behavioral health and human services agencies, including CCBHCs, with billing, state reporting and e-prescribing.
long_description: CareLogic is one of Qualifacts' enterprise EHRs, described by the vendor as an ONC-certified, web-based system built for behavioral health and human services organizations, including multi-location and multi-state agencies. Admins configure workflows by program, service and provider credentials, along with data collection and alerts. Qualifacts lists billing with workflow automation, state reporting and, for CCBHCs, configurable outcome measures, follow-up alerts, clinical decision support rules and PPS billing with daily or monthly rates. E-prescribing covers controlled substances, formulary and drug-interaction checks, medication history, prior authorization and PDMP access. The vendor cites SOC 2 Type I and II certificates, two-factor authentication and federated single sign-on. Qualifacts iQ AI documentation is available as an add-on. Pricing is not published; agencies get a quote, and Qualifacts' certification disclosures describe contractual and interface costs.
one_liner: Configurable enterprise EHR from Qualifacts for community behavioral health agencies and CCBHCs.
best_for: Community mental health centers and CCBHCs that need configurable CCBHC measures and PPS billing
Multi-location or multi-state behavioral health and human services agencies
Agencies with prescribers who need EPCS, PDMP access and prior authorization inside the EHR
Organizations that must submit state reporting data from clinical and administrative workflows
not_for: Solo therapists and small private practices
Practices that want published pricing and self-serve sign-up
Teams that want a ready-to-go system without configuration and implementation work
